newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded but steady, NYMEX firmer.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded but steady, NYMEX firmer.

text.p: July Brent crude futures were untraded at midday on Friday but indicated steady from London, supported by modest short covering on NYMEX.
July Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $18.25/$18.45 per barrel, after London fell 40 cents to settle overnight at $18.32.
Ample physical Brent supply weighed on the futures market to drag prices lower, but traders said there was support at the lower levels.
Ample stocks in the U.S. undermined NYMEX July crude too, which fell in New York 46 cents to $19.66.
However, NYMEX found some players buying back short position ahead of the weekend on ACCESS to take July to a last trade of $19.75, up nine cents.
Brent quotes were in line with NYMEX/Brent arbitrage values.
